english.title: Person making deposit or excavation fail to perform section 171(4) duty
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person who, with the consent of **(..SPECIFY AUTHORITY..), the highway authority in respect of **(..SPECIFY STREET..), a highway maintainable at the public expense,

(A)_[temporarily deposited building materials, rubbish or other things]_
(B)_[made a temporary excavation]_

in that street, failed without reasonable excuse to comply with your duty under section 171(4) of the Highways Act 1980 to comply with directions given to you in writing by that authority with respect to the erection and maintenance of traffic signs in connection with that

(C)_[deposit]_
(D)_[excavation]_

in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 171(6)(b) of the Highways Act 1980.
